column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST (cleat#3516): the test runs once per registered backend, so in this PostgreSQL-only job the mysql and mssql arms skip while postgres RUNS. Each dialect computes the digest with its own SQL (encode(sha256()), SHA2(), HASHBYTES()), so the arms cannot be merged.

dialect-gated per SUBTEST: same test, same two arms, and the cluster job runs ./engine/... too. See the test-go/engine line above. Measured on the cluster job of cleat#3518's head: it skipped /mysql and /mssql and ran /postgres.

dialect-gated per SUBTEST: this job sets only CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL, so the postgres and mssql arms skip while mysql RUNS. A specific line, so its skips leave the broad /postgres$ and /mssql$ pool. Measured on the multi-db/mysql job of cleat#3518's head.

dialect-gated per SUBTEST: this job sets only CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL, so the postgres and mysql arms skip while mssql RUNS. See the multi-db/mysql line above. Measured on the multi-db/mssql job of cleat#3518's head.
